tests/fixtures/look-bundle-synthetic.json is SYNTHETIC: three made-up rectangles and made-up values in ENGINE's look-bundle format (ryagram-look, version 1), with the ramp (edges, stops, anchors) copied from ENGINE's real Film 4 bundle so colours behave the same. It is NOT a real film and carries no real data. Real bundles are ENGINE's (ryagram.preview.look.build); Film 4's is 10.8 MB and is never committed. Generated by a one-off script from ENGINE's film4-look-bundle.json.
look-bundle-synthetic-banded.json and .js are the same kind of SYNTHETIC fixture in the engine's BANDED mode (mode "banded": solid colour bands with breaks, no ramp): three made-up rectangles, made-up values, bands chosen by hand. NOT a real film.
